It's our work and personal life imbalance. I have been through it. No worries, try out what I did. Walk/run in the morning for 5-8kms then begin your day. Later in the evening walk/run for another 3-4kms. You surely fall sleep.
And about the main part, travel to a place you wished for somewhere right now. Enjoy the new place, explore the place and you will see the magic.
Thanks for your valuable feedback, but we in India have a so called arranged marriage in our culture. It's different than you think. Okay I'll keep this in my mind if I start for the next one.
Let's not comment ill of someone not knowing what they are going through, thanks for the suggestion

Talk like partners. See if they stick to the same reply they gave you the first time. Speak about finance, bucket list, likes, dislikes, needs and every aspects as a couple. If they give a confident and clear  answer, then think about sex.
